capabilities: Browse Zotero items and annotation tags in three coordinated panels
Filter by collections, fields and tags, with simple search
Render items and annotations through Nunjucks templates
Copy, insert into the active note, or create new notes with Zotero-formatted bibliography
Cache the library locally and optionally copy annotation images into the vault
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that Nunjucks templates run with autoescape disabled, so only trusted templates should be used; compatibility tested only on Windows desktop with Obsidian 1.15.0 minimum.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse a Zotero library or turn its items, tags and annotations into notes.

relations.evidence: El plugin hace solicitudes de lectura a la API local de Zotero
Plantillas compatibles con Zotero Integration para tarjetas y salidas.

summary: Zotero library browser that filters items and annotations in coordinated panels and renders them into notes with Nunjucks templates.
